citation: "Chicago in 1820." — steel engraving, Pl. 27, "S. Eastman U.S. Army, from a sketch by H. R. Schoolcraft", in Henry Rowe Schoolcraft, Historical and Statistical Information Respecting the History, Condition and Prospects of the Indian Tribes of the United States, part IV (Philadelphia: Lippincott, Grambo & Co., 1854).
author: Seth Eastman, after a sketch made by Henry Rowe Schoolcraft at Chicago in 1820
describes_date: 1820, by its caption; Schoolcraft passed through Chicago with the Cass expedition in August 1820
repository: Newberry Library (NBY 1788), via Wikimedia Commons; the copy held in this repository is chicago/reference/images/chicago/chicago_settlement_1820_2.jpg (catalogued in chicago/reference/images/IMAGE_SOURCES.md)
locator: the whole plate, 1920 x 1407 px in the copy held here; the Kinzie farmstead is at the right, about x 1360-1580, y 640-790 px; the artist's line and 'Pl. 27' are lettered under the image
rights_note: Published 1854 in the United States, out of copyright by age.
access_notes: Read off the image file itself on 2026-10-15 (T-2498); the plate number and the artists' line are read off the scan. The volume itself was not opened from the run's container; its title and part are the catalogue's and the plate's.
what_it_supplies: the earliest picture of the house: end-on from the east, its gable toward the eye, the ridge along the river and the front slope carried low over the piazza on the river side
two stacks through the ridge, one just behind the east gable
two windows in the east end under the gable, and light, smooth walls
a log building, a whitewashed house and a yard fence round it in 1820
the second Fort Dearborn across the river to the left
what_it_does_not_supply: the house in 1812: it shows it eight years later, after the family's return in 1816
note: Drawn from a sketch made on the spot, which none of the other pictures of the house can claim. The plate also draws Native people in canoes and on the bank; nothing of them is built (AGENTS.md, the standing constraint). Its camera and match record are data/reference_views/kinzie_house_1812/eastman_1820.json.
